missing_groups.name: Thoracic subcutaneous fat
missing_groups.reason: No matching source concept/mesh; reconstruct and cite anatomical cross sections.

missing_groups.name: Thoracic fascia
missing_groups.reason: No matching source concept/mesh; limb fascia must not be repurposed.

missing_groups.name: Five lung lobe tissue surfaces and fissures
missing_groups.reason: PART-OF lung-lobe compounds contain airway and vascular elements; no independent parenchymal surface confirmed. Five actual MAL lobe meshes have been acquired in separate original coordinates; registration is required.

missing_groups.name: Separate left and right ventricular wall identities
missing_groups.reason: Shared ventricular wall FJ2428 is source-backed and retains sampled chamber voids; named PART-OF left/right wall compounds are unreliable. Separate regional identities require documented segmentation.

missing_groups.name: Interatrial and interventricular septa
missing_groups.reason: No specific source identity confirmed; cavity references are not septal tissue.

missing_groups.name: Costal cartilage for ribs 8 through 12
missing_groups.reason: Catalog has only separately named costal cartilages 1 through 7; inspect lower rib ends before reconstruction.

missing_groups.name: Complete intercostal vascular bundles
missing_groups.reason: Only first/second posterior arteries and selected thoracic vessels explicitly resolve; full numbered bundle coverage unconfirmed.

resolution_policy: Specific ISA leaf meanings first; PART-OF branch assemblies next; never repeat an elemental mesh. Cavity geometry is reference-only.
limitations: Source metadata is not independent anatomical validation.
Selected skin and crossing vessels require regional cropping with explicit termination treatment.
Open Anatomy and NLM references have not been spatially registered to the primary specimen.
Documented reduction is 99 percent; smoothing cannot recover missing anatomical detail.
